decisions.reason: As a homepage-highlighted flagship, it sits squarely in the firm's cloud messaging knowledge base, so management is likely to learn from early uptake and improve it rather than withdraw it.

It supports electronic document workflows and is important enough to have its own page, but it is somewhat more adjacent to the firm's core than messaging services, so it is kept with a higher review risk.
Email and fax conversion directly uses the firm's multichannel integration capabilities and serves legacy-heavy regulated processes that remain relevant in Germany, making withdrawal unlikely.
Fax delivery optimization is a close-to-core incremental enhancement that the firm can readily absorb and refine, so it is more likely to be retained or bundled than removed.
Sandbox threat protection fits the firm's secure communications positioning and can be developed with its existing infrastructure and security expertise, supporting continuation.
Multi-engine email virus scanning is tightly related to the firm's managed email security and compliance capabilities, so management would typically keep it as a complementary service.
